summary: Bihar's first-party Bhu-Naksha viewer is a local cadastral-map route for Rohtas/Sasaram and returned a bounded Special Survey extent in EPSG:32645. The exact WUP point was tested without shifting coordinates; the anonymous point route returned no parcel data, and no safe native ID plus polygon was retrieved. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: English and Hindi discovery queries are recorded in city-10841-sasaram.json. They identified the official Bihar Bhu-Naksha viewer, Directorate of Land Records & Survey, and Rohtas government map pages.
requestOutcomes: The viewer, configuration, current JavaScript, hierarchy REST responses, Sasaram selection metadata, and Special Survey extent loaded through ordinary public GET/POST. The exact point transformed to EPSG:32645 as [199546.42187871446, 2762932.174425789] and is inside the returned extent. getPlotAtXY returned has_data=N; ScalarDatahandler returned no parcel data; WMS GetFeatureInfo returned an image rather than usable feature JSON. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [24.9520568188232, 84.0245718623021] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or citywide absence inference was made.
The verified extent is for one Sasaram mauza and Special Survey map instance, not proven complete city coverage.
A zero exact-point hit, empty scalar response, map extent limitation, or unusable feature-info response is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No stable native parcel ID, source schema for parcel attributes, or full parcel polygon was obtained.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
